# Sourdough starter

Feed the starter twice a day with equal weights of flour and water. Keep it at room temperature; it is ready when it doubles in four to six hours and smells pleasantly sour. Discard half before each feeding so the jar does not overflow. A layer of grey liquid on top means it is hungry.

# Soft sandwich loaf

This loaf uses instant yeast, milk and a little butter. Knead for ten minutes, let it rise for one hour, shape it into a tin and bake at 190 degrees for thirty-five minutes. Brush the crust with butter while warm for a soft finish.

Tax return checklist for 2025. The filing deadline is April 15. Keep receipts for the home office: a share of rent, electricity and internet can be deducted if the room is used only for work. Charitable donations need a written acknowledgement above 250 dollars.

Car maintenance log. Change the engine oil and filter every 10,000 km or once a year. Rotate the tires every second oil change. The timing belt is due at 120,000 km. Last service: new brake pads on the front axle.

Bicycle care: wipe and lubricate the chain every 300 km, more often after riding in rain. Keep road tires at 6 bar. Check that the brake cables are not frayed and that the quick release levers are closed before each ride.

# Postmortem: primary database outage

On March 3 the primary Postgres instance stopped accepting writes for 47 minutes. The disk filled up because write-ahead log segments were retained by an abandoned replication slot. Action items: alert at 80% disk usage, drop unused replication slots automatically, and document the failover procedure.

# Runbook: Redis cache

The cache runs with maxmemory 4gb and the allkeys-lru eviction policy. If the hit rate drops below 90%, check for large keys with the bigkeys scan. Never run KEYS in production; it blocks the server. Restarting a replica is safe; restarting the primary flushes nothing because persistence is disabled.

Q2 planning meeting notes. Decisions: hire two backend engineers and one designer; launch the mobile app beta in May; postpone the billing migration to Q3. Risks: the payment provider contract renews in June and prices may rise.

Welcome! On your first day, collect your laptop from IT, install the VPN client and sign in with single sign-on. Request access to the code repository through the help desk form. Your buddy will walk you through the deployment pipeline in week one.

Japan itinerary: three days in Kyoto visiting Fushimi Inari, Kinkaku-ji and the Arashiyama bamboo grove, then two days in Osaka for street food in Dotonbori. A 7-day JR Pass covers the bullet train from Tokyo. Book the ryokan with dinner included.

Vietnam trip: start in Hanoi's Old Quarter, take an overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay, then fly to Hoi An for the lantern-lit ancient town and a tailor visit. Try bun cha and egg coffee in Hanoi. Carry cash for street vendors.

10K training plan, eight weeks. Three runs a week: one interval session (6 x 400 m at 5K pace with 90 s rest), one tempo run of 20 minutes, and one long easy run that grows from 6 to 12 km. Rest or cross-train on the other days. Taper in the final week.

Sleep hygiene notes: go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, avoid caffeine after 2 pm, keep the bedroom cool and dark, and stop using screens an hour before bed. If you cannot fall asleep within twenty minutes, get up and read until sleepy.

Houseplants: water the monstera when the top 5 cm of soil is dry, roughly weekly in summer. The fiddle leaf fig dislikes being moved and drops leaves after drafts. Snake plants tolerate low light and need water only once a month.

Home network: the main router is in the hallway closet. Place the mesh node on the second floor landing, not inside a cabinet. To factory-reset the router, hold the rear button for ten seconds; this erases the Wi-Fi password and port forwarding rules.

Monthly budget using the 50/30/20 rule: half of take-home pay for needs such as rent, groceries and utilities, thirty percent for wants such as dining out and travel, and twenty percent for savings and paying down debt. Review subscriptions every quarter.

Mortgage options: a fixed rate keeps the monthly payment stable for the whole term, while a variable rate starts lower but follows the central bank. Refinancing makes sense if the new rate is at least one point lower and we stay longer than the break-even period of the closing costs.

Photosynthesis happens in chloroplasts. In the light-dependent reactions, chlorophyll absorbs light and splits water, releasing oxygen and producing ATP and NADPH. The Calvin cycle then uses them to fix carbon dioxide into sugar.

The French Revolution began in 1789. The storming of the Bastille on 14 July became its symbol. The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen proclaimed liberty and equality; the monarchy was abolished in 1792 and Louis XVI was executed in 1793.

Beef pho: char onion and ginger, then simmer beef bones for six hours with star anise, cinnamon, cloves and fish sauce. Pour the hot broth over rice noodles and thin slices of raw beef; serve with basil, lime and bean sprouts.
Guacamole: mash ripe avocados with lime juice and salt, then fold in chopped onion, tomato, coriander and a little jalapeno. Press plastic wrap onto the surface to stop it browning.

Hợp đồng thuê nhà: tiền thuê 8 triệu đồng mỗi tháng, đặt cọc hai tháng. Bên thuê thanh toán trước ngày 5 hàng tháng. Không được nuôi chó mèo và không được cho thuê lại. Hợp đồng có thời hạn một năm, có thể gia hạn.
The washing machine warranty lasts two years from the purchase date and covers the motor for ten years. Keep the receipt. Damage from incorrect installation or limescale is not covered.

pages.text: Annual Report 2025. Letter to shareholders. Revenue grew 18 percent to 240 million dollars, driven by subscription sales in Europe. Operating margin improved to 14 percent as cloud hosting costs fell. We opened offices in Lisbon and Warsaw and ended the year with 1,150 employees.

Risk factors. Our hardware depends on a small number of chip suppliers; a shortage could delay shipments for several quarters. Currency movements affect reported revenue because most costs are in euros. New data protection rules may require changes to how customer analytics are stored.

Sustainability. In 2025 we installed solar panels on the roof of the main warehouse, which now supply 40 percent of its electricity. Business travel emissions fell by a quarter after we replaced short flights with train journeys. Next year we will publish a supplier code of conduct.

Installation. Place the dishwasher next to the sink so the drain hose reaches the siphon. Connect the inlet hose to the cold water tap and make sure the appliance is level by adjusting the front feet. The socket must be earthed; do not use extension cords.

Loading. Put plates and pans in the lower basket facing the centre, and glasses and cups upside down in the upper basket. Cutlery goes handles down. Do not wash wooden boards, cast iron or crystal glasses, which can be damaged by hot water and detergent.

Error codes. E1: no water supply - check that the tap is open and the inlet hose is not kinked. E4: leak detected - switch off the appliance, close the tap and call service. E9: door not closed properly. If the display blinks, reset by holding Start for three seconds.

Abstract. Marine heatwaves caused mass coral bleaching on the northern reef in three of the last five summers. We surveyed 40 sites and found that reefs with more herbivorous fish recovered faster. Protecting grazing fish may help reefs survive warming oceans.

Methods. Divers recorded live coral cover along fifty-metre transects at each site, photographing a square metre every two metres. Fish were counted in underwater visual census belts. Water temperature loggers were fixed to the reef at five metres depth.

Discussion. Recovery was slowest where seaweed overgrew dead coral. Fishing restrictions on parrotfish and surgeonfish are cheap compared with reef restoration, but they only buy time; reducing greenhouse gas emissions remains essential.

Pitching the tent. Lay out the footprint, spread the inner tent on top and insert the two long poles in an X through the sleeves. Clip the inner to the poles, then throw the fly over and match the coloured corners. Stake out the guy lines at forty-five degrees.

Care and storage. Never pack the tent away wet; dry it within 24 hours to prevent mildew. Clean with a sponge and cold water only, no detergent. Store loosely in a cool place rather than compressed in its stuff sack.
